answer: One concrete mechanism: stake the identity's own past earnings as collateral that jurors can slash, because karst only stays cheap while cloning pays only if the clone survives grading, so the amortized cost of a fleet rises. Concretely, whisper is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any willow approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
